title: Direct vicinal halo-nitration of unsaturated compounds: an overview
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42087-42098

Zahra Azizi, Zinatossadat Hossaini, Soumya V. Menon, Shahrzad Abdolmohammadi, Ruya Yilmaz Saber, Subhashree Ray, Karthikeyan Jayabalan, Aashna Sinha, Esmail Vessally
In this review, we spotlight the methodologies for the direct synthesis of β-halo nitroalkanes and nitroalkenes from the corresponding unsaturated hydrocarbons through vicinal halo-nitration strategies.
